reviews.comment: I didn't do great in his class, but he is an amazing teacher. Calc is hard, and he does his best to help his students out. The quizzes are easy; it's the exams that make or break your grade.

He was able to round my grade from a C to a B. He has a monotone voice but he explains and does the math questions in a manner that is understandable and quick to follow. I've never taken a pre-calc class before so this class helped me a lot as this is a required class to go further into harder math classes. The final exam replaces your lowest exam
Awesome professor and is really understanding if you can't make a quiz day. PICK HIM
Dr. Garcia was a great professor. The tests are the majority of your grade, but the final replaces your lowest score. He is very kind and has great office hours!

While I didn't engage too much with the class and just did my work. It was all prepared in an easy-to-understand manner and the professor was nice and made sure the class worked for us. There are plenty of resources for the class, and while it is test focused, it wasn't bad and the class was decent.

I LOVE THIS MAN!!!!!! He uses Iclicker and quizzes every Friday but makes everything so clear and is so organized. He is always available to help and is so understanding. He explains everything so thoroughly and encourages questions in class. IF YOU HAVE THIS MAN AS A TEACHER DO NOT CHANGE THE CLASS HE IS SO AWESOME! EVERYONE TAKE HIM!!!!!
It was tough to sit through his class as he is a very monotone speaker but his grading makes up for it. I suck at math and managed to pull a B.

He explains things very well and has lots of office hours. If you didn't take calc in high school, buckle up, it's very hard, but if you did, it's not too bad. There are so many resources to do well in this class; you just have to put the work in.

Easy class with an easy professor. Dr.Garcia is a great professor who teaches the class very well, and is understanding for external professional commitments. Don't skip class as he takes i-clicker attendance questions at random times, and missing multiple could tank your grade. Overall great person, great professor, highly recommended.

Easy class with an easy professor. Dr. Garcia is a great professor, teaches very well, and is understanding and accommodates for unknown events/external professional commitments. Don't skip class as he takes attendance i-clicker questions at random points in class, and missing them can take a toll on your average. Highly recommended taking him.

Great professor and has clear grading criteria. If you don't understand something, he will help you. Tests aren't bad if you have taken calc before or pay attention in class. Would 10/10 recommend for Math140.

Overall, he is a good professor. The class is very exam oriented (75% of grade). He has in class clicker questions which you can only do in person. He did well for it being his first semester teaching the course.

Professor Garcia is a good professor who made sure to thoroughly teach the material and go a bit slower/more carefully than most, which makes sense given it was his first semester teaching MATH 150.  I personally liked his teaching style and I found that he's very accommodating to students. Weekly quizzes, Webassign weekly, iClickers, and 4 exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Garcia is very meticulous during lectures, which can be helpful for people who have trouble understanding concepts right away. Going to his office hours help tremendously if there's any confusion or questions. I honestly thought the homework questions were more difficult than the test, but I recommend to still study for them. Quizzes weekly.

I took him for Math 150. He is really good, although his lectures do get just a little boring. Goes through all details. Other than that, his office hours are great and a tremendous help. A lot of studying outside of class though, questions on the test are a little harder than the notes or homework provided. Really caring guy, willing to help.

I took him for math 150. It was his first year teaching this course and it definitely showed sometimes but overall he is a smart man and knows what he is talking about. Half of the time you are in a separate smaller class taught by a TA so it kinda depends on who you get. Just be prepared to study a lot.

Not a bad professor by any means. if you're struggling go to his office hours as he's always willing to help you out. However, in his lectures he goes into extreme detail (oftentimes very tedious) on the rules of every little thing and it gets very boring very fast. His teaching style isn't for everyone so if you're not into that don't take him.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Not necessarily a bad professor, however, if you do not have a long attention span, I would not take this class. Usually over explains for me and ends up making the concept seem more difficult than it really is. BUT if you need a prof who will break down every individual step with tons of explaining, Id say take him.

Taken Fall 2024. Professor Garcia knows many people in Math 140 aren't good at math. He is a very by the book and formulaic professor, so if that isn't your thing, skip him. That being said, he is excellent at what he does and very caring. He will help with homework and problems in his Office hours, and he's usually very focused on you succeeding.
Math 142 is hard for a lot of students, and Garcia knows that. He simplifies lectures very well and makes things easy to understand. His office hours are helpful and he is very approachable.

Prof Garcia is a fine teacher. He will use up literally every second of class time no matter what. He is a bit of an over-explainer as someone who had already taken calculus in high school. He does seem to enjoy his job and wants his students to succeed. His office hours are helpful, if you are struggling.
Amazing guy. Just saw him at a lucy dacus concert. best prof you'll have. use your resources!!

genuinely one of the best profs ive ever had. he teaches the material very well. the exams arent too bad. the biggest thing is to watch out for time. he goes through the material very thoroughly, so hes great for people who are first time learners for calc. he provides a lot of resources to study for the exams. final replaces lowest. a great prof

(I am manifesting an A... i have yet to take the final) Dr. Garcia was really nice! He was super accessible outside of class for office hours if you needed help with homework/the lesson. He was a slow lecturer, but I never really minded because it helped me understand the lesson more. He also provided us many resources for extra practice if needed.
I had to teach myself everything, his lectures were not helpful at all and boring.

Great professor for a tough class. Explains everything very well and is very understanding. I got sick 1 hour before our final and he let me take it another day no questions asked. If you go to class and utilize the 140 tutoring center you will get a A!
Dr. Garcia was a great professor. He explained everything very thoroughly which could get a bit boring but was overall very helpful. He is very helpful and cares about his students success.

Dr. Garcia is a great professor. He goes painfully slow over very basic concepts so if that is something you need, he is great. Sitting in lectures are so boring but sometimes he does iClicker questions so I show up. You can tell he cares about his students and knows how to teach.

Great Teacher, Probably one of the best 140 teachers based off what I hear. His lectures are slow and you might fall asleep but he knows what he's talking about and is super nice. He doesn't respond to emails but if you go in person he will answer every question. Must study to get at least a B.

Great guy! He knows what he's talking about and is very kind. The only issue is that he is not very good at responding to emails. Attendance isn't mandatory, but he does iClicker participation questions for a grade.

Garcia was so patient and kind, straightforward with everything stated in the syllabus. This class was tough if you're not a math person like me, regardless of professor. Study for the exams because I almost got an A in the bag, but the final was so difficult because I didn't study too much. He made this class better overall, so highly recommend.

I am not a math person but Mr. Garcia makes you feel like it's so easy! He never fails to explain something and will think of different ways to explain it until you understand. Engaging! He genuinely cares and wants his students to succeed. Just make sure you come to class to hear the lessons and take group quizzes :) I absolutely adored this man!

If you're not the best at math, take him! He goes painstakingly slow over common sense parts of the lecture. I'm no math guru but I often skipped ahead because he is too slow. Exams are mild with class averages typically in the 70s. On free response questions, he will deduct points if you use the wrong method, even if you get the right answer.

He is an amazing professor!! I have never been good at math in high school, but after having him for 140 and 142, I truly understand all the math concepts to a solid level. He always goes slow in lectures to make sure everything is easy to grasp before building on the more challenging content. If you need to take 140 or 142, take him 100%!!

Professor Garcia is the best prof I've had at A&M. Cares about his students and makes himself very accessible outside of class for help. Thoroughly explains the content so it's easier to understand. Although calculus is hard in general, I was able to get an A even though I did not take calc in high school. Best professor here. Take his class!!
Great professor
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Garcia might be the kindest professor on campus. He is always easy to access outside of class. His lectures can run a little long at times, but if you pay attention you will get any necessary information. Amazing professor.
Attendance is important. He is not consistent on giving quizzes but you do not know when it will be if you skip class. Tests are easy. He dropped one of our test grades.
Dr. Garcia talks very slow in order to make sure everyone understands the content.
tests are easier than the homework, just look over the practice tests and pay at least half attention in class

Try to take Dr. Garcia for Math 140 if you can. Go to class and pay attention. Do the homework with friends or in office hours. Don't bs the homework because doing it will prepare you perfectly for the exams. Do all of the work, go to office hours if you're confused (he is really easy to reach), and you should get an A. Incredibly nice, patient guy

homework due Wednesdays (usually 2), tests are identical to practice exams, the material is easy to grasp, and Professor Garcia teaches pretty slowly so it's tough to fall behind. The only bad thing is that lectures can get boring and he's a slow grader, but the class is free. The final was cumulative but similar to his exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Garcia is knowledgeable and easy to understand. The content itself is extremely simple and should not be hard to manage. Sometimes the lectures get boring because he does go pretty slow and grading does take a while, but other than that, great professor.

Dr.Garcia was the best professor I had in my semester.He takes his time teaching a unit so that everyone is on the same page. Math 140 is very easy tbh and garcia makes the class way easier. He is very caring and he is always accesible outside of class so if you're struggling, go to him.Attendance is not mandatory but there are iclicker questions.

Dr. Garcia is awesome. Math 140 is really simple im ngl but his lecture style is super thorough and detailed to the point where anyone can succeed regardless of what level of math they are. He's also super flexible with makeup work and in general is a great guy. Lectures are in-depth and he does drop grades so getting an A is very easy

Excellent professor, this is unfortunately the last math class I have to take but if I had to do more, I would make him a priority teacher to have. He always comes to class prepared and ready to dive straight into the material, and is flexible with allowing students to finish the pre-class lecture videos after class instead. Very kind & personable

Professor Garcia is knowledgable and very helpful. The course load is kinda a lot and it's easy to fall behind but there's a lot of extra help. Office hours especially at the beginning of the week is the best time to go because it's basically one-on-one. Overall, very cool professor if you get to know him. He is always willing to explain and help.
Gives homework and video participation which are sometimes short. Great explaining and cares for his students.

He was very clear and understood the course and material very very well. Very knowledgeable and helpful. Knows how to teach in a way that is easily understood. One of the best instructors I have ever had.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I thought that he was a great professor and took his time going over each of the topics that we learned. The only reason why I don't have an A in his class is because I don't do or finish the WebAssign homeworks. I would recommend for math 142.

Math 142 is a horrible class in general but he is a good professor. GO TO OFFICE HOURS if you are struggling. This saved me, he was able to explain the hard concepts until I understood and he is very patient. There are many professors that will make this class more difficult on purpose so I definitely recommend taking him over others.
Bradford is great! I had him for 140 and it's quite a bit of material, but simple enough. Would highly recommend it.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Garcia genuinely cares about his students. Lectures can be kind of slow because he takes time to explain details/let students ask questions. Graded by clicker questions, quizzes, webassign homework, tests, and a final that replaces the lowest test grade. I actually understood most of what was taught in this class. Would 100% take again.

There are quizzes every Friday, but if you pay attention, they're easy. The exams are kind of difficult, but he posts a ton of resources to help you out, and if you use them, the exams are simple. This was his first semester as a prof, but he was awesome! Super flexible with meetings and times, and really cares about his students! 1000% recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: lecture-heavy but a short quiz at the end of the week. The only thing I didn't like was that he would try to rush on the last 10 mins and speed up the lecture just to go over it again in the next class which just left you confused out of class.  Lots of office hours were available and right before an exam had zoom office hours.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: honestly a great professor, he takes his time to go into detail about topics. this can sometimes lead to us getting a little behind and having to rush a bit near test time, but he also hosts extra office hours, both online and in person, the week of an exam. he truly wants you to do well in the class!

Professor Garcia was an awesome prof. His lectures were a bit slow paced for me, but I'd rather slow than fast. I don't understand people saying he's confusing because he actually goes into a lot of detail which is why his lectures are slow paced. He's very communicative with the class, and exams are fine if you study. He wants you to succeed!

Dr. Garcia is an amazing professor. His lectures are easy to understand, he always slows down to ask for questions, and he grades with fairness. He goes a little bit too slow for my taste, but that isn't necessarily a bad thing. With any background in math you should be able to get an A in his class.

Nice professor who cares about his students. Test are much harder or reversed of what is in reviews. He goes over everything with a level of confusing detail. If math is easy for you, then take this professor and if not, take it at a community college. he final replaces your lowest test grade, but if tests were easier there wouldn't be a need.

Takes forever to grade (sometimes over 3 weeks), but not that bad of a lecturer. He has quizzes every friday in class but they are not too bad. Class itself was not too hard but he goes extremely slow and then has to rush at the end before the exam.

I think he could have gone into depth more on some topics, especially during exam two. I would recommend taking this class at a community college rather than at A&M because this class is test-heavy. He takes forever to grade exams as well. One nice thing about the course is that the worst test grade gets dropped if your final exam is better.

Nice guy but his explanations in class are very long winded. I often found my mind wondering because of his overly complicated explanations. Hes has clicker questions but not every class, so attendance is iffy. In class quiz ever Friday. He wants you to succeed, but his teaching is not straight enough to the point for me.

Dr.Garcia is the best professor! He made class easy, organized, & understandable while still stopping and asking if we had questions/needed clarification. His office hours were helpful if you needed to attend. He doesn't take attendance but he does have clicker questions which can be at any time that count towards your grade. Regardless take him!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Take this professor, trust me. Hands down best prof at A&M.
10/5 Best TA Ever. Speaks clearly, easily accessible, knowledgeable.

Bradford was my TA for MATH-151 and did a great job. He was very caring and wanted each student to succeed. He was also very accessible outside of class and held office hours longer than he had to just so he could accommodate all his students. While he wasn't my professor for this class, I would recommend him as a professor in the future!
Bradford is hands-down the best TA I've ever had. SO helpful with everything. He really cares for his students.
